name: Atlassian Cloud site edge tenant info (public, unauthenticated)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P371 provider_tier 'trusted' (council #1).

reliability.justification: First-party edge answer of the requested <name>.atlassian.net site (cloudId JSON vs the edge 'Page Unavailable' 404); the endpoint is undocumented, and a site under a name never proves which organisation owns it (P371 FC5).

tenant_info.title: Atlassian Cloud tenant discovery: https://<name>.atlassian.net/_edge/tenant_info (200 {cloudId} = site exists, edge 404 'Page Unavailable' = no site)
tenant_info.notes: Research C0797, live 2026-11-26 (batch p3-G13-1): ecosystem.atlassian.net answered 200 {"cloudId": ...} (server AtlassianEdge); a random name answered 404 text/html 'Atlassian Cloud Notifications - Page Unavailable' from the edge. The same page with a 5xx status is an outage (could not verify). Login, signup and user endpoints are never requested (rule 2, P371 FC3). Politeness budget (not published by Atlassian): 0.5 request/s and 60 per day per egress, one GET per candidate, no retries.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G13-1 (P371, module saas_tenant_discovery). Only the fixed FC2 path is ever built and redirects are never followed; the candidate name is the only value Atlassian receives.
